priorityList: Use Death Sweep or Annihilation if the Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs from Reaver's Glaive are active.
Cast Reaver's Glaive if its associated buffs are down and Essence Break is not active.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or the Empowered Eye Beam buff is active.
Cast The Hunt as a major cooldown, ideally when Essence Break is down.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative or Inertia procs before Eye Beam or Blade Dance.
Cast Eye Beam if Blade Dance is on cooldown and Essence Break is not active.
Cast Essence Break during Metamorphosis if Fury is available and Blade Dance is ready or soon to be ready.
Use Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) as your highest priority spender, especially during Essence Break.
Use Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) if Death Sweep is on cooldown, or if Chaos Theory is active.
Cast Immolation Aura to generate Fury, prioritizing it when at two charges or to maintain Ragefire.
Cast Felblade to generate Fury if you are below 40 or need to close the gap to the target.
Use Fel Rush to trigger Inertia or as a filler if no other generators are available.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler if Soulscar is talented and you have no other spenders or generators available.
Use Arcane Torrent if low on Fury and all other generators are on cooldown.
